results.alertTitle: Sign-in attempts against disabled account johns@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com

summary.tpReason: Four disable_accounts_CL records corroborate the alert: johns@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com was targeted from 175.45.176.99 via Azure Portal, and Entra error 50057 states the account was disabled. The attempts failed, but the activity is real and suspicious.
summary.fpReason: The alert is dated 2026-08-18, while raw authentication times are 2021-04-19 and the raw AlternateSignInName has a different suffix. This indicates timestamp or enrichment inconsistency, not absence of the four matching failed events.
summary.whatHappened: Four interactive Azure Portal attempts targeted johns@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com (JohnS, user ID 14dc6e86-42b9-4f0a-8da0-8b5bdc62e336) from 175.45.176.99. Raw times were 2021-04-19 12:13:19Z, 12:13:31Z, 12:16:30Z, and 12:16:34Z; all failed with error 50057 because the account was disabled. The alert was generated 2026-08-18 14:45:57Z. The same IP also produced 53 successful sign-ins to adelev@m365x816222.onmicrosoft.com on 2021-11-03.
keyEvidence: disable_accounts_CL contains exactly four matching records: target johns, source 175.45.176.99, Azure Portal, interactive Browser, ResultType 50057, and explicit disabled-account failure reason.
disable_accounts_CL AuthenticationDetails provides the four failed authentication timestamps and common correlation ID d655a0b1-dcd7-4fea-af0c-c8d5c82a7917.
Raw sign-in location is KP/North Korea (Pyongyang); this is telemetry-provided and may be affected by VPN/proxy use.
sign_in_adelete_CL contains 56 sign-ins from the same IP to adelev on 2021-11-03: 53 successes and 3 failures across Azure Portal, Teams, Exchange, SharePoint, and Office web apps.
SecurityAlert c4a8c80f-1c83-1842-31c6-e68352fdfb07 matches the four attempts, source, target, and application.
summary.nextAction: Confirm johns remains intentionally disabled. Treat 175.45.176.99 as hostile pending validation; investigate the 53 adelev successes, revoke sessions and reset credentials if unauthorized, review audit activity, and block the IP. Reconcile the 2021 raw event times with the 2026 alert time and fix timestamp enrichment.
